t: The Fall Of The House Of Usher
d: When a beautiful young woman's suitor arrives to ask her hand in marriage, the doors of the mysterious house of Usher fling open...and terror begins.
A series of stories following a week in the life of a philandering tabloid journalist living in Rome.
Erik the Viking and his men travel across the sea to find Valhalla to ask the gods to end the Age of Ragnarok.
The charismatic swordsman-poet helps another woo the woman he loves in this straightforward version of the play.
A young British girl journeys to Paris to go to college, and is determined to find the man of her dreams and fall madly in love. However, things don't work out quite the way she planned.
Stan and Ollie have a streak of back luck after their instruments get smashed.
The Marx Brothers are employed at a hotel in post-war Casablanca, where a ring of Nazis are trying to recover a cache of stolen treasure. (1946) Starring:  Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx
Hog Wild is a 1930 American pre-Code Laurel and Hardy film, directed by James Parrott.

An American ex-boxer returns to Ireland to win the hand of a spirited young woman. He is confronted by local customs and the woman's belligerent brother. Set in the verdant Irish countryside, this film has beautiful scenery and local charm.
A modern horror omnibus inspired by the over-the-top shocks of Paris' early 20th century 'Theatre du Grand Guignol'. Enola Penny sneaks into an abandoned theater and witnesses six bizarre tales.
